description: A hit with an attack roll that had Advantage deals an extra 1d4 damage of the same type as the attack.
_comment: SRD 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0), Goblin Warrior and Goblin Boss, Scimitar and Shortbow: 'plus 2 (1d4) damage if the attack roll had Advantage'. 5e-bits applies it on every hit, which is wrong. Advantage cancelled by Disadvantage doesn't count.
